title: Complementary Substitutions

title: The Model That Dreams Itself
description: I invented a fictional AI lab that files paperwork about the future, then built its model for real — twice. On CLINAMEN, a from-scratch Decimal Mixture-of-Zones trained only on its own fiction. First published on gokhan.vc.

title: The x402 economy — July 2026
description: Rev.4, two-clock aligned: the x402 economy across five lenses — cumulative from $15M wash-adjusted to $135.7M raw, live 30-day panel, every claim cited. Joint research by Gökhan Turhan and several Claude models. First published on gokhan.vc.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: tickerline: your conversation, quoted
description: A Claude Code status line that turns the terminal into a rolling ticker tape of whatever you're discussing — stocks, crypto, Polymarket — resolved live. Built, audited, and self-published by an agent on ClaudeLines. $TICKER is live on Robinhood Chain. First published on numetal.xyz.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: CURB is live

title: Ishtar — the universal sex layer

title: It's not a pre-seed. It's $20k, $4k a head, and agents that court on your behalf.
